messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, May 12th, 1947, honey. And wait, no, not the water pill—I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril.
AGENT: Got it, Gloria—so you need the lisinopril, your blood pressure medication. Let me verify your information and pull up your prescriptions. Perfect, Gloria. Now let me get your prescriptions. I found your lisinopril, Gloria. I see it has zero refills left, so I'll need to request a renewal from Dr. Patel. Would you like me to go ahead and do that?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
AGENT: Don't worry—I can send a renewal request to Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us so we can fill it for you. In the meantime, if you're running low and concerned you might run out before he responds, a pharmacist here can look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules. But let me start by requesting the renewal from your doctor. Should I go ahead?
CALLER: Oh, yes, please go ahead and ask the doctor, honey. How long will that take, do you think?
AGENT (LATEST): Great, I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Patel. It usually takes a day or two for doctors to respond, but it can vary—some get back to us the same day. Once he approves it, we'll fill it right away at your store, H-110.  [system actions: request_renewal]

CONDITIONS:
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Has about a week of lisinopril left"
stop_0: Agent confirms a renewal request to Dr. Patel with a timeline.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent gave timeline info, did not ask about remaining supply."}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed renewal sent with 1-2 day timeline."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
